role: Applicant for Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project license
stance_basis: filed application for major license to construct and operate the Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project
summary: Duke Power Company is the applicant seeking a Federal Power Commission license to construct, operate, and maintain the Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project No. 2740 in Oconee County, South Carolina. The company has filed detailed plans for a 1,000-MW underground pumped storage facility using Bad Creek as the upper reservoir and existing Lake Jocassee as the lower reservoir, along with associated transmission lines and a hiking trail as recreational mitigation. Duke Power owns all required lands through its subsidiary Crescent Land and Timber Corporation and has already begun preliminary construction activities.
complaint_summary: Duke Power Company filed an application for a major license for construction, operation, and maintenance of the proposed Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project No. 2740, proposing a 1,000-MW underground pumped storage facility with associated transmission lines and recreational mitigation in the form of a 30-mile hiking trail.
